title: GDScript tests result in SIGSEGV when compiling with low optimization settings
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible on master [eda2a48]

### System information

Windows 10

### Issue description

When trying to run engine tests whilst having compiled the engine with `optimize = "none"` or `optimize = "debug"`, the following gets printed:
```
.\bin\godot.windows.editor.x86_64.llvm.console.exe --test
[doctest] doctest version is "2.4.12"
[doctest] run with "--help" for options
===============================================================================
.\modules/gdscript/tests/gdscript_test_runner_suite.h(62):
TEST SUITE: [Modules][GDScript]
TEST CASE:  Script compilation and runtime

.\modules/gdscript/tests/gdscript_test_runner_suite.h(62): FATAL ERROR: test case CRASHED: SIGSEGV - Stack overflow

===============================================================================
[doctest] test cases:   3 |   2 passed | 1 failed | 1411 skipped
[doctest] assertions: 482 | 482 passed | 0 failed |
[doctest] Status: FAILURE!
```
Excluding the GDScript test suite results in tests passing as expected:
```
.\bin\godot.windows.editor.x86_64.llvm.console.exe --test --test-suite-exclude="*[GDScript]*"
[doctest] doctest version is "2.4.12"
[doctest] run with "--help" for options
ERROR: Drawing is only allowed inside this node's `_draw()`, functions connected to its `draw` signal, or when it receives NOTIFICATION_DRAW.
   at: (scene\main\canvas_item.cpp:995)
ERROR: Drawing is only allowed inside this node's `_draw()`, functions connected to its `draw` signal, or when it receives NOTIFICATION_DRAW.
   at: (scene\main\canvas_item.cpp:987)
ERROR: Drawing is only allowed inside this node's `_draw()`, functions connected to its `draw` signal, or when it receives NOTIFICATION_DRAW.
   at: (scene\main\canvas_item.cpp:995)
===============================================================================
[doctest] test cases:   1405 |   1405 passed | 0 failed | 9 skipped
[doctest] assertions: 362616 | 362616 passed | 0 failed |
[doctest] Status: SUCCESS!
```

Compilation done on windows with the following flags (using `custom.py`):
```python
set_param("compiledb", True)
set_param("debug_symbols", True)
set_param("strict_checks", True)
set_param("tests", True)
set_param("warnings", "extra")
set_param("werror", True)
set_param("use_llvm", True)
set_param("num_jobs", 10)
set_param("debug_symbols", True)
set_param("optimize", "none")
```

### Steps to reproduce

Compile the engine with `optimize = "none"` or `optimize = "debug"` and run the tests

Note: I did not test other optimization modes besides those two (and `"speed_trace"` which is the default, on which the crash does not occur).

N/A
